description: ED v62: the v58 recipe retrained from scratch on the ES PRODUCTION pool rebuilt with the FIXED 3-plane matcher (partner = most energetic induction candidate). Same architecture, preprocessing, optimizer and schedule as v58; v58's own train/val split is not recoverable (unseeded shuffle, no file provenance), so a fixed-seed 0.70/0.15/0.15 split BY SOURCE FILE is used and a real held-out test set exists. Loss is v58's angular loss with a safe acos clip (v58 went NaN at epoch 13; its deployed weights are the epoch-12 checkpoint).

data.selection: v58 training selection (data_loader.load_three_plane_matched): X match_id != -1 and the (event, match_id) pair present in U and V; no main-track requirement on the partners
data.preprocessing: raw float32 ADC, channel dim appended, no normalization (as v58 / pipeline ed_inference.py)
